brand.name: OpenDating
brand.notes: Two overlapping circles represent people connecting. The vertical stem on the right represents growth, connection, or 'upright' dating. The overlapping area is the shared connection space. Coral (#E8735A) is the primary brand color — warm, human, approachable. Animations should feel warm, organic, and convey connection.
